nativeProofs.scope: All current load/cache/phone-condition/retained-count checks pass. The selected activity coordinate is physically reached; this is not completion of every activity.

nativeProofs.label: Native phone manual view/tracking and shutter
nativeProofs.scope: Actual touch look and unobstructed native shutter events; selected exercise completes and persists. MoPOP retains a missed pass, waits for real animation frames and reacquires the moving train. Initial nearby setup is explicit.

nativeProofs.label: Native phone elevator cancellation
nativeProofs.scope: Seven real host-mode cancellations restore the original floor without an award. A separate animated ascent reaches the Loupe. The later shutter locator failure is retained; successful Loupe controls are separate.

visitorGallery.notice: 5 matched walking-height viewpoints in each of four conditions, captured from the recorded production game source. Open any picture at its original size.
visitorGallery.setup: Production app, scene, actors, lighting and renderer at High quality, 1280 × 800. Automatic animation was paused and explicit frames rendered at fixed on-foot cameras 1.65 m above their supporting surfaces. Local simulation dates and weather were controlled; capturedAt records the real capture time.
limitations: Fixed on-foot appearance fixtures; cameras were positioned for inspection. These pictures do not establish a traversed route, activity completion, physical-phone behavior or hardware FPS.

The Loupe picture is taken on its modeled supporting floor, not a drone. It does not establish a completed elevator ride or an accurate distant Seattle skyline. Snow particles currently appear inside the modeled Glasshouse; indoor weather occlusion needs work. The captured High-quality submitted workload reaches 1,532,282 triangles / 473 draw calls; full-scene performance remains open.
